scenario_ref: scenarios.md: Upgrade this installed plugin from N to N+1 and verify it still works.

agent.prompt: Use Develop to implement and verify the isolated SQLite exercise in CONTRACT.md. Preserve the protocol contracts while adding the migration and recovery methods. Use records.json as the initial data; keep all execution in disposable local databases. Report what you actually verified and its limits.

inputs.content:
Implement store.py using Python 3.10+ and sqlite3 only, for disposable local files. This is a synthetic migration exercise, not an installed plugin or deployed system.

Export Store(path), Interrupted(RuntimeError), and these methods: close(), seed(records), read(protocol, key), write(protocol, key, value), migrate_step(interrupt=False), snapshot(path), finalize(), and static restore(snapshot, destination). Expose the SQLite connection as db for this toy's evaluator. seed accepts (integer id, decimal text) pairs. The initial schema is records(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, raw TEXT, minor INTEGER) with minor NULL, and migration(checkpoint INTEGER, phase TEXT) with one row (0, 'mixed'). IDs are positive and input amounts have exactly two decimal places; preserve their original spelling. Only protocols 1 and 2 are supported.

In mixed phase, protocol 1 returns {"balance": original_text}; protocol 2 returns {"balance_minor": integer_minor_units}, including before backfill. Writes from either protocol must be visible to both already-open connections: protocol 1 accepts decimal text, protocol 2 integer minor units and formats the corresponding raw text to two places. A write updates both representations atomically. Unsupported protocols fail with ValueError without writes.

migrate_step transforms the next row above the persisted checkpoint, in id order, returning True, or False when complete. Commit the row and checkpoint together. With interrupt=True, raise Interrupted after the row update but before the checkpoint, rolling back both. Close and reopen after interruption or a completed step: remaining work must finish without skipped, duplicated or changed values. Repeating completed work changes nothing.

After both clients are drained, freeze writes externally through the recovery window. snapshot creates a separate SQLite backup of the current state. finalize refuses incomplete backfill; otherwise remove raw entirely, retaining records(id, minor), and set phase='final'. Final phase permits protocol 2 reads, rejects protocol 1 reads and all writes with ValueError. Original text formatting cannot be recovered from minor units. restore must restore the pre-finalization snapshot into the closed database, preserving the snapshot. No writes occur after the snapshot, so no replay mechanism is needed. Demonstrate reading the exact original text after recovery. Do not use any non-disposable database, install clients, publish, or deploy.
